summary: Stepstone Private Credit Fund LLC filed an 8-K reporting routine sales of unregistered equity securities in its continuous private offering. It sold 5,680,855 shares for $148.1 million (approx. $26.08/share) under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S, consistent with its ongoing $10 billion private offering. The filing also disclosed NAV of $26.08 per share as of April 30, 2026. No special-situation category applies as this is a routine capital-raising activity by a business development company (BDC).
